name: Land title due diligence, Telangana and Andhra Pradesh
description: What a buyer's advocate checks before a sale. Edit this file to change the standard; no code change is needed.

rules.subject: encumbrance_status
rules.message: The encumbrance certificate shows a charge on this land. A subsisting mortgage with no registered release deed means the seller cannot pass clear title.

rules.subject: land_classification
rules.message: The land is not classified as freely transferable patta land. Assigned, inam, endowment and government land cannot be sold: transfer of assigned land is prohibited under the AP Assigned Lands (Prohibition of Transfers) Act 1977, which applies in Telangana, and a sale is void with the land liable to resumption. An allowlist is used here on purpose, so a classification nobody anticipated fails closed rather than passing silently.

rules.subject: survey_number
rules.message: No survey number could be read from the file. Without it the parcel cannot be identified against the revenue record.

rules.subject: extent_acres
rules.message: No extent is stated anywhere in the file.

rules.subject: owner_name
rules.message: No recorded holder could be identified from the documents.

rules.subject: document_date
rules.message: No document date could be read, so the order of the title chain cannot be established.
